origin.name: M27Exec.kext's executable
origin.note: the row's unstamped M27Exec.kext/Contents/MacOS/M27Exec, as the kext folder (declared whole in patch.json) installs it

edits.reason: M27Exec binds to the kernel collection this image boots: stamp_identity.py writes that BootKC's kernel identity (UUID, symbol table, activator table, the addresses M27Exec calls) into __DATA,__m27_identity; on any other kernel the kext stays inactive. The BootKC is linked on the target, so the stamp is made there, after it
edits.evidence: apply.sh runs the row's stamp_identity.py on the image's BootKernelExtensions.kc after the ditto; tests/test_edits.py (M27_OPENCORE_M27_RUNTIME, M27_OPENCORE_IMAGE_EFI) shows an image's M27Exec differs from the row's only inside __m27_identity
